title: AC1021 metric FIELD repeated UpdatedDistance body-tail screen
scope: Classify the exact 258-bit residual on the hash-bound AutoCAD 2007 metric FIELD records, determine whether it is sufficiently specified for a parser change, and select the next independent raw-only carrier candidate without repeating source acquisition or selected-record cursor work.

primaryAuthority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
primaryAuthority.finding: Section 20.4.76 describes the FIELD value and repeated child-value sequence, but does not describe an additional UpdatedDistance text item or the two residual bits after the decoded children. Section 20.4.99 does not assign those bits a CadValue meaning.

tailProbe.method: Temporary local diagnostic read the remaining bounded object-data bits after the current FIELD parser had decoded the known value and child-value sequence. Diagnostic source change was removed before the baseline rebuild.
tailProbe.independentMinJsonCorrelation: LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON identifies all 42 FIELD expressions with the UpdatedDistance property suffix. It does not expose a separate semantic tail member or physical span for these residual bits.

baselineRecheck.result: Baseline behavior is restored: all 42 records remain incomplete raw FIELD shells and strict conversion refuses before creating output.

independentVerboseTrace.firstBadChild: child[2] has empty key at @29.5; format_flags=17302012 at @33.7; data_type=0 at @34.1
independentVerboseTrace.coordinateLimit: These are LibreDWG-decoded object-local bit cursors and object-map coordinates, not physical compressed-file byte offsets or normative wire proof.

nextCandidate.localDiagnostic: unsupported FIELD CadValue format flags 17302012; child value payload unsupported
nextCandidate.independentMinJson: The source-bound LibreDWG minJSON record has a third child value with format_flags=17302012, type=0, and a nonzero unit field.
nextCandidate.boundaryStatus: Candidate identity and the peer's first bad child are correlated, but libdxfrw's body/string cursor at that child and the peer's next-object map boundary are not yet recorded as a paired span. Bind those for this one record before any decoder change.

decision.tailDisposition: Keep all 42 records raw-only. Do not interpret UpdatedDistance as a serialized property name or treat the final 10 bits as padding, alignment, or a flag without an authoritative layout or independent physical decode.
decision.profileScope: The metric AutoCAD 2007 source remains the sole P5-B target. The 42 tails account for one raw-only carrier class; the remaining target candidates are the 14 child-format-flag failures, one invalid child count, and nine AcSm child-count failures recorded in S31.

limits: Repeated identical bits and correlation with the FIELD expression are source-local observations, not proof of a DWG field schema.
The independent minJSON view does not independently decode the residual tail or bind its physical span.
This slice does not qualify FIELD serialization, graph publication, strict DXF output, readback, or native evaluation.
No DWG/DXF fixture or derivative was added. No parser change was retained.

closed: Classify all 42 identical 258-bit residuals and verify their source-local FIELD-expression correlation.
Restore the baseline parser, rebuild dwg2dxf, and verify that strict conversion still fails closed without creating a DXF.
remaining: For FIELD 0x3aaf0, bind the first-divergent body/string cursor, child-value span, raw flags payload, handle stream, and following-object map boundary against ODA and the source-bound LibreDWG record before trying one candidate decode.
If no bounded, authority-consistent decode succeeds, retain the 14 records raw-only and move to the one invalid-count record and the nine AcSm records without widening the source profile.
Preserve all 162 FIELDLIST identities; strict output remains refused until every member has a lossless, graph-closed DXF disposition.
implementationReadiness.nextAction: Do not revisit the 258-bit tail absent new schema evidence. Use FIELD 0x3aaf0 as the next one-record cursor investigation; make no parser change until source spans and the following boundary agree.
